notes: Closed-form capsule/segment queries against an infinite plane: contact separation and point, linear sweep time of impact, and segment entry fraction (0 when the start is inside). A Cargo-native case covers a floor: separated contact, a landing sweep, parallel motion that misses, a segment entering from outside, starting inside, and receding.
deterministicPerformance: constant work per call with no loops or allocation; no work counters are reported.
criterion: no benchmark suite is added for these constant-time closed forms.
